basic_profile.bio: A young professional from Ohio exploring the vast world of Reddit. With a newfound interest in hair care and alternative remedies, I'm often diving into discussions around unconventional treatments. Outside of Reddit, I work as a junior software developer and enjoy playing indie games. In a relationship and usually online during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Recently started exploring various topics on Reddit, especially around hair care and gaming. Picks up knowledge from online forums and occasional YouTube videos. No formal education in these areas, mostly driven by personal curiosity.
